description: Configurable AI coding assistant for VS Code.
config.title: BezotCorp AI
config.provider.description: AI provider used by BezotCorp AI.
config.providerUrl.description: Provider URL. Ollama default is http://127.0.0.1:11434. Custom backend default is usually http://127.0.0.1:4188.
config.model.description: Model name used by the selected provider.
config.autonomyMode.readOnly: Only read and search tools are available.
config.autonomyMode.confirm: Everything except reading inside the current VS Code window asks for permission unless already granted.
config.autonomyMode.acceptEdits: File changes inside the current VS Code window go ahead without asking; commands, network and MCP still ask.
config.autonomyMode.auto: Nothing asks, except operations matched by an ask rule. Deny rules always apply. Choose this explicitly.
config.autonomyMode.description: How much the AI may do on its own. Only read from user settings.
config.permissions.markdownDescription: Tool permissions kept for all sessions, by tool identity: `{ "edit_file": "allow", "git_push": "deny" }`. Values: `allow` (no question), `ask` (confirm at each call), `deny` (the tool is not offered and cannot run). A tool without an entry uses its default: reading and consulting tools allow, the others ask. MCP tools are named `mcp__server__tool`. *BezotCorp AI: Manage Permissions* can also keep tool decisions for the current session and manages remembered filesystem resource permissions separately. Only the tool decisions kept for all sessions are stored in this user setting.
config.protectedPaths.markdownDescriptio: Extra protected resources, added to the built-in ones (`.env`, `.env.*`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `id_rsa*`, `.npmrc`, `.git`, `.ssh`, `.aws`...). A protected resource is never read, changed, moved or deleted without asking, whatever a tool is allowed to do, and stays out of the context, searches and git output. A bare name or glob matches at any depth; `//abs/path`, `~/path` and `path` (from the workspace root) are also accepted.
config.contextTokens.description: Context window requested from the model, in tokens (num_ctx for Ollama). It bounds how much conversation history is sent. The model's own maximum applies when lower.
config.mcpServers.description: MCP servers started over stdio, keyed by name: { "name": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "server"], "env": {}, "cwd": "" } }. Only read from user settings.
